appearances.whereabouts: Falme streets, then a shed, then approaching the damane quarters
appearances.notable_actions: Leads the rescue mission, channels to open a damane collar, captures a sul'dam named Seta, forces the bracelet onto Seta and discovers it works on her, prepares to infiltrate the damane compound
appearances.demeanor: grimly determined, angry, focused, nervous about channeling

appearances.whereabouts: Falme streets watching for Seanchan, then the shed, then heading to damane quarters
appearances.notable_actions: Serves as lookout, helps capture and subdue the sul'dam, wrestles Seta into the shed, helps with the disguises

appearances.whereabouts: Falme streets watching for Seanchan, then the shed, then heading to damane quarters
appearances.notable_actions: Serves as lookout, shouts encouragement to the freed damane, helps capture Seta, prepares to wear the collar but Nynaeve changes the plan
appearances.demeanor: eager, bouncing nervously, willing to sacrifice herself, relieved when plan changes

appearances.whereabouts: Falme streets, then captured and taken to a shed, forced to wear damane collar and dress
appearances.notable_actions: Walking with a damane when attacked, tries to escape after being captured, begs not to wear the collar, forced to cooperate under threat, reveals sul'dam can be controlled by a'dam
appearances.demeanor: startled, then struggling, then terrified when collared, pleading, crying, finally compliant under threats

appearances.whereabouts: On his ship docked in Falme harbor
appearances.notable_actions: Waits for the women to return, orders his crew to prepare to cut mooring lines, threatens to split the skull of anyone who cuts lines early, watches the town nervously
appearances.demeanor: tense, nervous, determined to wait for the women, protective

appearances.notable_actions: Questions the plan, worries about Seanchan soldiers

appearances.whereabouts: Riding into Falme, through horse lots, into Turak's house, then fighting Turak
appearances.notable_actions: Enters Falme with the group, helps locate the Horn, sees Egwene wearing a damane collar from Turak's window, duels and kills Turak in single combat using the void but refusing saidin, vows to rescue Egwene, flees with the Horn
appearances.demeanor: tense, determined, shocked by seeing Egwene collared, desperate during the duel, horrified after killing Turak, torn between duty to the Horn and saving Egwene

appearances.whereabouts: Riding into Falme, tracking Fain's scent, in horse lots, in Turak's house
appearances.notable_actions: Tracks Fain's scent through Falme streets, helps scout the house, fights Seanchan soldiers, watches from the window
appearances.demeanor: nervous but dutiful, focused on his tracking ability

appearances.whereabouts: Riding into Falme, entering Turak's house, fighting Seanchan
appearances.notable_actions: Leads the raid to recover the Horn, kills a Seanchan guard in the garden, touches the Horn with awe and says 'I am saved', fights soldiers, insists they must leave immediately, tries to convince Rand to abandon Egwene, drags Rand away
appearances.demeanor: feverishly intense, obsessed with the Horn, awestruck when he sees it, urgent and commanding

appearances.whereabouts: Riding into Falme, in Turak's house, fighting Seanchan
appearances.notable_actions: Senses the dagger's location, grabs both Horn and dagger, kills a Seanchan soldier with the dagger causing horrific corruption and death, refuses to give up the Horn to Ingtar, tosses the Horn over the wall, flees with it
appearances.demeanor: pale and drawn, obsessed with the dagger, triumphant when he recovers it, shaken by the crazy behavior of Seanchan servants

appearances.whereabouts: Riding into Falme, in Turak's house, fighting Seanchan
appearances.notable_actions: Fights with his axe, kills soldiers, looks sick afterwards, exchanges glances with Rand about the situation
appearances.demeanor: reluctant, snarling wordlessly in battle, sick and disturbed after killing

appearances.notable_actions: Discovers the intruders stealing the Horn and dagger, has his servants remove his robe, draws his heron-marked sword, duels Rand, tests Rand's skill then grows more serious, is killed by Rand using River Undercuts the Bank
appearances.demeanor: calm, uninterested in their weapons at first, soft-voiced, surprised then concentrated during the duel, arrogant confidence that fades to concentration

appearances.whereabouts: In a garden behind a house across the street from Turak's residence
appearances.notable_actions: Walks in the garden wearing a damane collar linked to a sul'dam, looks up and seems to make eye contact with Rand, disappears into a building
appearances.demeanor: collared, leashed, walking in pairs with other damane as prisoners

appearances.whereabouts: Not physically present but his scent/trail is throughout Falme, especially near Turak's house
appearances.notable_actions: His scent crisscrosses the town, was at Turak's house recently (possibly last night), suspected by Turak of killing a guard and wanting the dagger
